summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Vault Drive (Expo dark-only) + FastAPI backend. 23/23 pytest backend tests passed against public URL (auth, folders, files CRUD + share/trash/restore/permanent, stats, activity, plans, docx/xlsx exports, user isolation). Frontend mobile viewport (390x844) tested: splash→login redirect, admin login, dashboard greeting+stats+quick-access+recent activity, sidebar drawer with all 7 nav testIDs, navigation to /files and /plans, register flow creating a new user and signing in, and Pro plan upgrade (POST /api/plans/upgrade returned 200 and UI updated to 'Current plan'). No red screens, no API failures.

issues: Non-blocking console warnings: shadow* style props deprecated (RN web), props.pointerEvents deprecated. Expo version mismatch warnings for @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, expo-document-picker, expo-file-system, expo-image-picker, expo-sharing (not affecting this run but worth aligning to expected versions).

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web warnings.
Optional: align Expo SDK package versions flagged by expo-doctor (async-storage@2.2.0, expo-document-picker ~14.0.8, expo-file-system ~19.0.22, expo-image-picker ~17.0.11, expo-sharing ~14.0.8).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~716 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, files, folders, plans, export) into modules for maintainability.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically inconsistent (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Not a functional issue for current token-in-header auth but worth tightening to explicit origin if cookie-based auth is later enabled.

storage_used is NOT decremented when a file is moved to trash — only on permanent delete. This matches the implementation comment and is intentional, but /api/stats semantics are worth confirming for UX.
seed_data_creation: Tests register transient users (test_reg_*, test_iso_*) and upload a small TEST_hello.txt which is permanently deleted in the same run. Admin remains unaffected; storage_used stays 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all documented endpoints. Frontend testIDs confirmed: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit, register-{name,email,password}-input, register-submit, goto-login, menu-btn, nav-{dashboard,files,recent,starred,activity,trash,plans}, signout-btn, upgrade-plan-btn, upgrade-{pro,premium,premium_plus}, search-input, new-folder-btn (labeled 'Folder'), upload-btn. Mobile viewport 390x844 works; on mobile the sidebar is hidden and opened via menu-btn.
